notes: For Ethereum mainnet (chain 1). START (argument 9 of PleaLaunch) = 1795532400 = Tue 2026-11-24 15:00 UTC, the unix time from which anyone may seed (the owner may seed earlier); $owner = the launch owner, a fresh wallet (the owner cannot play seasons). The code is run 8's (branch testnet8, the mainnet code rehearsed on Sepolia, audited by the swarm in rounds 5 to 8) with exact share bands (run 8.5): run 6's code plus letters without the 0.35 IMD auto-sell fee (only the site's auto-sell box pays it), LetterTooLong(bytes, 280), season points = score x 1.2 (rounded down) when the seller holds an IMD seat NFT at record time (Seasons' fourth argument = the identity.md NFT 0x0000ec93127baa929e58e97dd0095a2bfb38ec1d; points only), the owner fee raised to 1% (2.25% in all: 0.5% cashback, 1% owner, 0.25% prize pot, 0.25% wall, 0.25% of the PLEA burned), the cap ratchet to its 900,000 PLEA floor in 15 days, PleaDistributor Ownable2Step, the recalibrated need (fact score 0-45: share sold at most 20%: 16, at most 35%: 9, more: 3; held 7 days: 7, 3 days: 4, 1 day: 2; at a loss: 13, gain at most 50%: 12, 200%: 10, 500%: 8, 1,000%: 6, more: 4; PLEA no buy record covers: held since trading opened, profit 10, a plea larger than the buy record taking the PLEA-weighted mean of both; 24h trend up: 9, flat: 5, down: 0; need = 71 minus the fact score, CannotPass above 45; the judges' 0-45 scale and definitions unchanged; a letter pleads 20%), and a 14,000 IMD seed market cap. The factory deploys PLEA, CabalGate, Seasons, PleaDistributor and PleaLaunch in this order, with zero ETH, in one transaction, under Ethereum's 16,777,216 per-transaction cap with a 22% gas-limit headroom (test/LaunchManifest.t.sol asserts it). Constructor arguments: PLEA(owner = $owner). CabalGate(PLEA, Intake v2 0xa43e6f75ee006411f79ac1c84120606c2330de82, oracle fee asset = IMD 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7, pool IMD (same), oracle signer 0x5598Aa9146215Bc13eb26f2c692Ad1461Fd32982, season 1296000 s = 15 days, dead-man 118800 s). Seasons(PLEA, CabalGate, IMD, seat NFT). PleaDistributor(PLEA, owner = $owner). PleaLaunch(PLEA, CabalGate, Seasons, PleaDistributor, Uniswap v4 PoolManager 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90, IMD, imd/acc's mainnet Stacker 0x06909f672301f28a810f78cfe7a754851269f4f0 (launch #1409), credit gas 400000, START, the Letterbox's oracle fee asset = IMD, mintOracleFee = false (the Letterbox buys the 0.5 IMD oracle fee with the writer's PLEA together with the tip), the keccak256 of the Letterbox's creation code, and the keccak256 of the Tribunal's creation code (nonzero: Objection! on). The agreed clock and the 14,000 IMD opening market cap are checked by PleaLaunch.seed on the live chain. After the launch, anyone calls PleaLaunch.deployLetterbox(creationCode) once (about 5.6M gas, its own transaction) and PleaLaunch.deployTribunal(creationCode) once (about 5.3M), then PleaLaunch.deployHook(salt, initCode) with a salt mined off chain; PLEA.init mints 82% to the hook, 6% to Seasons and 12% to PleaDistributor (the swarm's 10% and a 2% airdrop, one Merkle root set once by the owner); seed() opens trading at a 14,000 IMD market cap once the hook, the Letterbox and the Tribunal exist (PLEA's owner any time, anyone from START). Seasons pays the top 25 wallets with at least 60 points from 450 down to 350 basis points of the IMD pot and of the 10,000,000 PLEA bonus in each of the first six seasons. Objection!: for 20 minutes after an approval anyone but the seller and the excluded owners may object through the Tribunal (0.5 IMD oracle fee and a 0.35 IMD stake, both in IMD on mainnet); a fresh panel re-scores the plea; the recorded score becomes the lowest any panel gave, sustained (no points, stake back) when the new score is more than 2 below the need, otherwise the stake goes to the plea's season pot; at most two objections per plea from different wallets, both may be pending at once; the sale is never touched.
